transcript:
This is NPR News Now, the latest headlines every hour.
>> Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Lyndi Kenyon.
A top House Democrat is expanding his investigation
into the venture capital fund, 1789 Capital.
As NPR's Barbara Sprunt reports,
the president's eldest son Donald Trump Jr. was brought
in as a partner in the firm days
after his father won reelection last year and returned
to the White House to become the 47th president
of the United States.
>> Jamie Raskin, the likely incoming chair
of the House Judiciary Committee, sent letters on Monday evening
to four companies backed by 1789 Capital,
defense contractor Hadrian, vape maker Jewel,
prediction market Polymarket,
and the online firearms seller Grabagun.
The Maryland Democrat requested two years worth of documents.
He's investigating whether the president's son used his
political influence to boost the companies.
An attorney representing 1789 Capital called the allegations
personal attacks untethered to actual evidence.
This is one part of a broader oversight agenda for Democrats
when they take control of Congress in January.
Barbara Sprunt, NPR News, Washington.
>> Israel is celebrating the return of NVIDIA's CEO.
NPR's Daniel Estrin in Tel Aviv reports the chip-making company
has driven big economic gains for Israel.
>> NVIDIA has a large research
and development presence in Israel.
According to Israeli government statistics,
NVIDIA's revenue contributed to nearly half
of Israel's economic growth this past quarter.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu welcomed the return
of Jensen Huang as NVIDIA's CEO.
Netanyahu said continuity
for the company's leadership was good news.
And Israeli President Isaac Herzog spoke to Huang
after he was reinstated to the company.
The Israeli President thanked Huang for supporting Israel,
quote, "especially during this challenging time,"
an apparent reference to Israel's international isolation
because of the Gaza War.
Daniel Estrin, NPR News, Tel Aviv.
>> New research shows people taking GOP-1 drugs
for weight loss may also see higher breast density
in subsequent mammograms.
NPR's Yuki Noguchi.
The study being presented at the Radiological Society
of America looked back at 107 women, age 39 to 79,
who had gotten mammograms before and after starting a regimen
of GLP-1 drugs like Wagovia or ZEP bound.
Breast density increased for 62.5% of women.
Normally, dense breasts are associated
with higher breast cancer risk,
in part because the fibroglangellar tissue can
obscure tumors.
But in this case, researchers are not yet certain
that the tissue composition of the breast
or the cancer risk changes with GLP-1 use.
The researchers advise people taking the drugs
to continue routine breast cancer screening as recommended.
>> You're listening to NPR.
More than a dozen, half a dozen Colorado ski areas are set
to open this holiday week, with several delaying their first day
of operation due to warm weather.
Beaver Creek is the latest to push back its opening day
until after Thanksgiving.
Colorado Public Radio Steena Sieg reports.
>> Beaver Creek Resort says the delay is despite the foot
of new snow that fell last week.
It simply isn't cold enough yet
at the ski area's lowest elevations to operate.
Beaver Creek joined several other resorts
that have announced they'll open later
than originally projected.
Last winter, many resorts opened behind schedule due
to warm, dry weather, creating the worst snowpack in decades.
This winter, resort owners
and skiers hope the climate phenomenon known
as El Nino will deliver lots of snow.
But meteorologists say there is no guarantee.
For NPR News, I'm Steena Sieg in Grand Junction, Colorado.
>> FIFA confirms the U.S. will co-host another soccer World
Cup event.
It will be the 2031 Women's World Cup,
co-hosted with Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica.
The U.S.-led 2031 project offers FIFA a choice of stadiums
in 20 cities.
Fourteen of them will be in the U.S., four will be in Mexico,
with the rest in San Jose and Costa Rica,
and Kingston in Jamaica.
And for the first time, the 2031 edition will be expanded
to feature 48 teams, just like the Men's World Cup.
I'm Lynda Kenyon, NPR News in Washington.

topics.text: House Democrat Jamie Raskin expands probe of 1789 Capital and Donald Trump Jr.'s involvement
Israel celebrates NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement, citing the chipmaker's economic contributions
Study finds breast density rising in most women taking GLP-1 weight-loss drugs
Beaver Creek and other Colorado ski areas delay openings due to warm weather
FIFA confirms U.S., Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica will co-host 2031 Women's World Cup
